The '''Eighth Army''', also known as '''Bright Jewel Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]]. One of the Northern Campaign [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] [[Army/Legends|Armies]], which consisted of [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]] [[Systems Army Delta|Delta]], [[Systems Army Epsilon|Epsilon]], and [[Systems Army Zeta|Zeta]], the 8th Sector Army focused its operations during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] worlds of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Because of the focuses of its operations, the 8th Sector Army saw some of the heaviest fighting of any of the Sector Armies, to the extent that several of the reserve commands repeatedly reinforced it.<ref name="TEGTW" />
